verdicts.originalText: The taunt mechanic isn't modelled (flagged via the taunt tag for now). C4's +25% tick rate (interval 1s → 0.75s) is not modelled — base tick interval is rendered for all constellations.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the taunt, and C4's +25% tick-rate boost. Ticks are shown at the base 1s interval for every constellation — C4 shortens them to 0.75s.
verdicts.rationale: Both items are genuine omissions on the CANNOT list (taunt has no visible timeline surface; tick-interval scaling isn't schema-supported per the burst _curatorNotes), so this stays a rewrite. Compression fixes the banned 'modelled' spelling (twice), swaps 'rendered' for 'shown' (render-family is banned in prose / rule 7 prefers 'shown'), and demotes the curator-facing '(flagged via the taunt tag for now)' parenthetical. The +25%, 1s, and 0.75s figures and the all-constellations scope are all preserved.

demotedNotes: Taunt is surfaced only via the taunt tag as a placeholder; no dedicated taunt behavior is modeled.
